item: A card-audit member the log guard paused is recorded skipped-paused, not error
summary: Before: while the write-ahead log is pinned the card-audit member raises HeavyPaused (503, no chained timeout) and the member loop wrote it as an error, so the error tally counted the guard working. After: matched by class name through the MRO, it is outcome skipped-paused with a skipped-paused marker file; a real failure is still an error.
